appraisal_events.evidence: Oriane était tellement plus intelligente, tellement plus riche, surtout tellement plus à la mode que ses sœurs...elle en avait fait...quelque chose d'admirable et de distinctif, que peut-être ses sœurs...essayèrent de masquer comme un défaut.
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator dwells admiringly on how the duchesse turned her distinctive, rustic-toned voice and manner into a mark of charm and originality, contrasting her favorably with her sisters, who suppressed the same trait as a flaw.

status_effects.explanation: The narrator praises the duchesse's wit, intelligence, and artistic distinctiveness at length, comparing her favorably to celebrated actresses for turning a potential defect into a triumph of style.

She is described as far more fashionable and socially prominent than her more obscurely and modestly married sisters, and as having previously held sway with the Prince of Wales, marking a clearly elevated social position.
